dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: There is a saying: "No matter how many things rise and fall in this world, a clear spring will always flow alone."

dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: Scholars should stay true to their hearts and tell elegant stories. If they only speak of mundane affairs, they might as well say nothing...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...

dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: I lack such talent, for I only count as a jade artisan and half a poet. But in the past, I would also occasionally tell stories at the Yilong Wharf teahouse.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: See you, then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: From before?

dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: Recently, a youth has been coming to the teahouse, telling of the most humdrum happenings in the streets, thinking to please the public.

dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: A joke about a Fontainian who made a fool of themselves while drinking tea here, a story about a Mondstadter who was knocked out after drinking three bowls of a local spirit there...

dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: While it's true that outsiders don't understand our traditions and do many outlandish things, it's better to only discuss such things over a cup of tea or after meals.

dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: On the stage, it's better to speak of more elegant affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A jadeworker?

dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: Hah! When I was young, I was one of the best jade artisans in Chenyu Vale.

dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: There's always an inextricable connection between beautiful jade and fascinating stories.

dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: As such, I would tell my neighbors stories I had heard while carving jade, which made me somewhat famous in the area.

dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: Nowadays, I occasionally give my disciple some of my jade works to sell on my behalf.

dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: If you go to Yilong Wharf, you can visit my disciple's store. Maybe you'll come away with jadeware piece that tickles your fancy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: As long as tempers have cooled off, and everyone's feeling happier.

dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: I'm not angry at all. I just feel like it's a shame.

dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: Yilong Wharf's a real riot compared to Qiaoying Village, so I get why travelers restlessly spoil for some fun while passing through.

dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: However, at the end of the day, Chenyu Vale has Adeptus Fujin and our thousands of ancestors who endured great hardships to lay foundations down for us, so that there might be endless stories worth telling.

dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: As such, a mixture of mundane matters and elegant tales of the past should be told on stage.

dialogues.speaker: Deyin
dialogues.text: I wonder when that youth will understand...
